# Which module each source file of this package belongs to. Every module but the kernel bridge and the shell is a package of its own now;
# this is the line the last of them was cut along.
# Read docs/server-modules.md (backend/docs) for what each module is, what it owns and why the files sit where they do.
#
# kernel        what every module stands on: the Core (store, CA, organisation, audit, clock), settings, secrets, rate limits, the
#               outbound address policy, the Kubernetes interface, install image settings. It is the package internal/kernel and
#               depends on nothing in this one; the only file of it here is the bridge, which is the Core with the methods the
#               modules add to it.
# accounts      people, organisations, roles, sessions, API tokens, passkeys and two-factor; the vocabulary of who is calling (Actor,
#               Principal, Role) and the one decision of what a caller may do (Decide). It is the package internal/accounts; no file
#               of it is left here.
# agents        an enrolled agent: tokens and enrolment, the stream, consent and access tier, diagnostics, the agent's own health. It is the
#               package internal/agents; the live picture of all of them (the hub) is the estate's.
# estate        what the server knows about the world: the hub, the per-agent views, the twin built from them, the history recorded as it
#               changes, the applications graph, the saved workspace. It is the package internal/estate, the top of the hub cluster; its
#               HTTP half is the shell's, and no file of it is left here.
# telemetry     telemetry intents and the quick-start backends. It is the package internal/telemetry; its HTTP half is the shell's.
# operators     regional operators: their certificates, senders, addresses, heartbeat. It is the package internal/operators; their HTTP half
#               is the package internal/operatorsapi, apart from the address candidates and the server's cluster, which read the hub's
#               facts and are in internal/estate, the heartbeat receiver (open, authenticated by its own secret) and the node probe of the
#               server's own cluster, which are the shell's.
# observed      what the flows say: the table of observed edges, the sanitising of a flow batch, the topology read off them and the index of
#               the addresses a cluster is known by. It is the package internal/observed; pure, it knows no agent and no hub, and no file of
#               it is left here.
# connectivity  paths, links, tunnels, addresses a cluster dials, the config an agent is told. It is the package internal/connectivity; no file
#               of it is left here.
# fusion        the FUSION stack: its control, retention and release naming. It is the package internal/fusion; its data API, proxy,
#               OpenAPI document and UI access guard are the shell's.
# advice        the decision loop: advice, proposals, outcomes, decisions.
# shell         the process and HTTP shell: the admin mux and its guards, the platform of organisations, routes, readiness, metrics.
#               It wires modules together and may use any of them; none may use it.
#
# A file added to the package must be added here, in the same change: a test fails otherwise.
admin.go                        shell
admin_agents.go shell
admin_fusion_proxy.go shell
admin_images.go                 shell
docs.go shell
fusion_appinfo.go shell
fusion_extras.go shell
fusion_guard.go shell
fusion_selfmetrics.go shell
fusion_ui_access.go shell
graph_api.go shell
kernel_bridge.go                kernel
links_wire.go shell
metrics.go                      shell
operator_heartbeat_receiver.go shell
readiness.go                    shell
routes.go                       shell
self_probe.go shell
tenants.go                      shell
wire.go shell
